requiredCases.proof: Allowlisted admin wallet sign-in and single-use email code; exact Operations treasury debit, fee and fixed admin credit; persistent pending intent and finalized audit receipt; destination tampering and duplicate submission rejected.
Finalized creation, immutable fee owner and shares, exact community reserve, developer allocation and escrow deadline; registered receipt matches chain.
Reviewed RICH burn and exact balance/supply reductions finalize before creation; cancelled creation can recover without a second burn.
Fresh selected-network quote, slippage and fee caps, finalized token/SOL deltas, trade history and trading fee recipient.
Finalized collection and cumulative settlement reconcile gross receipts to every category without double counting.
Fixed beneficiary and exact payout; repeated requests cannot transfer the same obligation twice.
Verified funding, eligibility snapshot, recipient proofs, actual net receipts and conserved reserve.

Complete UTC cutoff evidence, eligible creator/referral/trader rankings, exact funded allocations and recipient SOL credits; retain unfunded obligations, reject duplicate payments, and reconcile the same receipts after worker restart.
Real identity verification and bound wallet; wrong identity rejected; exact payment and idempotent claim.
Operations, all referral levels, community and agency accounting reconcile to immutable allocations; no eligible recipient retains funds rather than rerouting.

Before migration: canonical Pump curve; after migration: canonical PumpSwap pool. Both require independent price review, approved fee-vault budget, slippage cap, finalized CPI purchase and burn, exact vault and supply reductions, empty purchased-token account, replay rejection, and worker restart reconciliation; failed execution retains obligation.
Migration snapshot and published root; authorized recipient, exact vault debit, duplicate/ineligible/expired claims rejected.
Early release rejected; selected lock period enforced; elapsed release pays only original beneficiary and cannot repeat.
Restart after submission, timeout and duplicate event preserves signed transaction identity, reconciles finality, and never resends a new payment blindly.

stopConditions: RPC genesis, deployed bytes, authority, program ID or configuration differs from reviewed release
Planned maximum spend exceeds remaining approved budget
Any financial delta or receipt does not reconcile
Transaction finality is unknown; reconcile before any retry
Worker readiness is stale, metadata unavailable or database persistence fails

rollback.firstAction: Disable public writes and stop financial workers; preserve journals and pending obligations.
rollback.reconcile: Check every recorded signature against finalized chain state before resuming or retrying.
rollback.application: Restore the previous verified application image only if compatible with current program state and schema.
rollback.program: No automatic downgrade, authority change, buffer closure or account migration. Require a separately reviewed compatible recovery transaction.
rollback.devnet: Keep the existing Devnet environment and database isolated and available.
